Black Pepper Powder Wholesale Price for B2B Buyers

Tradenest Naturals supplies consistent black pepper powder for food manufacturers, distributors, exporters, restaurants, and private label brands. Our black pepper powder wholesale price depends on grade, mesh size, order volume, packaging, and delivery destination. We offer practical support for buyers comparing black pepper powder price per kg and planning reliable bulk supply. Our product comes from carefully selected black peppercorns. We clean, grind, and sieve the spice under controlled food-processing conditions. As a result, buyers receive a uniform powder with strong aroma, balanced heat, and dependable performance across recipes. Tradenest Naturals works as a black pepper powder manufacturer, supplier, and exporter from India. We also support buyers seeking a bulk black pepper powder supplier India for regular imports, food production, and private label programs. Request a sample and quotation to confirm your preferred specification.

Product Overview

Black pepper powder comes from mature dried berries of the Piper nigrum plant. It adds warm pungency, spicy aroma, and mild citrus-like complexity. The powder blends easily into dry mixes, sauces, marinades, snacks, and ready-to-cook products. We can supply standard commercial grades and customer-specific specifications. Therefore, buyers can select the mesh size, packaging format, label design, and shipment quantity that suit their operation. Our team reviews each inquiry before confirming the final price and supply plan.
  • Clean, finely ground black pepper for food applications.
  • Uniform particle size for consistent blending and dosing.
  • Additive-free product unless a buyer requests an approved custom formulation.
  • Suitable for domestic distribution and export shipments.
  • Available in bulk, wholesale, retail-ready, and private label formats.

Manufacturing and Processing

First, we source black peppercorns through established agricultural and ingredient networks. Next, our team checks the raw material for appearance, aroma, cleanliness, and suitability for grinding. We then remove unwanted particles before processing. After cleaning, we grind the peppercorns to the selected particle size. Controlled grinding helps protect the natural aroma and limits excessive heat during processing. We then sieve the powder to improve uniformity. Finally, we pack the finished product in food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging. Our process includes batch identification and production records. In addition, we follow standard operating procedures for cleaning, grinding, sieving, packing, and storage. These controls help support consistent quality between repeat orders.

Typical Technical Specifications

Standard specifications may vary by customer requirement and destination-market regulations. The following values represent a typical commercial profile for black pepper powder.
  • Mesh size: 80 to 100 mesh, or as agreed.
  • Moisture content: 10% maximum, subject to final specification.
  • Purity: 99% minimum by typical commercial specification.
  • Appearance: Fine, free-flowing dark brown to black powder.
  • Flavor: Strong, warm, pungent, and characteristic of black pepper.
  • Ingredients: 100% ground black pepper, unless otherwise agreed.
  • Processing: Cleaning, grinding, and sieving.
For larger contracts, we can review particle size, moisture target, microbiological requirements, packing material, and labeling details before production. Buyers should request a product specification sheet and sample for approval before placing a final order.

Quality, Documentation, and Standards

Quality begins with raw material selection. Our team checks each batch through documented inspection steps. These steps support traceability, moisture control, cleanliness, and consistent product presentation. Applicable quality standards depend on the destination country, customer use, and import regulations. We prepare commercial and product documents according to the agreed order requirements. These may include a commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, batch details, product specification, and other documents required for the shipment. We do not assume that one certification applies to every buyer or market. Instead, we review certification needs during quotation. Customers can share their required standards, test parameters, labeling rules, or import documents. We then confirm available documentation before production or dispatch.

Applications

Black pepper powder offers efficient seasoning performance in both industrial and foodservice recipes. Its strong flavor allows controlled dosing in many products. In addition, the fine powder disperses easily during dry and wet mixing.
  • Seasoning blends for snacks, namkeen, popcorn, and French fries.
  • Instant noodle masala, soup mixes, and ready-to-cook foods.
  • Marinades, sauces, gravies, dressings, and dips.
  • Processed meat, poultry, seafood, and plant-based food products.
  • Bakery savory products, crackers, biscuits, and filled snacks.
  • Restaurant, hotel, café, and cloud-kitchen food preparation.
  • Private label spice packs and retail seasoning products.
  • Custom spice blends and contract-manufactured food formulations.

Buyer Value

  • Consistent mesh supports repeatable blending and production results.
  • Bulk purchasing can improve cost efficiency and simplify procurement.
  • Moisture-resistant packaging helps protect freshness during storage.
  • Flexible pack sizes support distributors, manufacturers, and retail brands.
  • Batch traceability improves purchasing control and quality review.
  • Long shelf life supports inventory planning and export distribution.
  • Custom packaging enables private label and branded market launches.
  • Direct manufacturer support simplifies specification and quotation discussions.

Packaging and Shelf Life

We pack black pepper powder in food-grade, moisture-resistant materials. The correct pack depends on order volume, storage conditions, market requirements, and transport method. Export orders receive packaging suitable for handling and international transit. Typical packaging options include 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg, and 25 kg packs. We can also supply bulk bags, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, and custom printed private label packaging. Each shipment can carry product identification, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, net weight, storage instructions, and applicable regulatory details. The typical shelf life is 18 to 24 months from manufacture when the product remains sealed and stored correctly. The final shelf life depends on the agreed specification and packaging format. Keep the product in a cool, dry, clean place. Protect it from direct sunlight, humidity, heat, and strong odors. Close opened packs tightly after each use.

MOQ, Lead Time, Samples, and Quotes

The minimum order quantity for black pepper powder wholesale price depends on product grade, pack format, and customization. Our typical starting MOQ for standard bulk supply is 100 kg. Private label, printed packaging, and custom formulations may require a higher MOQ, often from 500 kg or as confirmed after review. Lead time normally ranges from 7 to 15 working days after specification, artwork, payment terms, and packaging approval. Custom export orders may require additional time for procurement, testing, labeling, and documentation. Therefore, we confirm the schedule with each quotation. To request a sample or quote, send your required quantity, mesh size, destination country, packaging format, label needs, and target application. Also share any required quality documents or import standards. Our team will then provide availability, pricing, sample options, and estimated delivery details.

Why Choose Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals supports B2B buyers with manufacturing, bulk packing, private label, and export services. We focus on clear specifications and practical supply solutions. Moreover, our wider food ingredient portfolio supports customers that source multiple powders, spices, seasonings, and premixes. We aim to build long-term partnerships through dependable communication, consistent processing, and responsive technical support. In short, buyers receive more than a commodity purchase. They gain a food ingredient partner that can support product development, cost optimization, packaging selection, and repeat supply.

Frequently Asked Buyer Questions

What affects the black pepper powder price per kg?

Price depends on raw material grade, season, mesh size, order volume, packaging, testing, and delivery location. Request a current quotation for your exact requirement.

Can you supply bulk ground black pepper for export?

Yes. We supply bulk ground black pepper in export-ready packaging. We review destination requirements before confirming the order.

What certifications and quality standards apply?

Requirements vary by market and buyer. We confirm available product documents and customer-specific compliance needs during the quotation process. We do not claim certifications without verification.

Can you provide private label packaging?

Yes. We offer custom printed packaging and private label support, subject to artwork approval and applicable MOQ.

Can I receive a sample before ordering?

Yes. Buyers can request a sample for sensory, application, and specification review. Sample availability depends on the required grade and pack format.

Request a Wholesale Quote

Contact Tradenest Naturals for current black pepper powder wholesale price, sample availability, and export supply options. Share your target volume and technical requirements. We will respond with a clear, application-focused quotation.
